title: Avoiding an anchor state
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a set, let $w$ be a finite Boolean string, let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ work tapes over Boolean symbols and states $S$, let $a\in S$, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $w$, and let $t\in\mathbb N$.
